title: 第13章 父母的担忧
content_zh:
宿舍里，王炳文老师被刘济民整得哑口无言，又见他一副滚刀肉的样子，更是气得无可奈何。

    “有你们这些学生，我...”王炳文长叹了一口气后，匆匆离开了宿舍，直奔学校行政楼而去。事情闹到了这个地步，已经不是他能够处理的了，他得赶紧向上级领导汇报。

    不过就算他不汇报，估计此事学校也都知道了。毕竟《光明日报》的记者来到学校是大摇大摆的进来的，更是在学生群体中引发了巨大的轰动，校领导想不关注都难。

    当王炳文快步走进行政楼的时候，许多领导已经在讨论这件事情了。每个人手里都拿着一份《光明日报》，有的人脸色阴沉，有的人则满脸赞许。

    校领导的分歧很大，王炳文刚汇报完，就有人告诉校领导：《光明日报》的记者想要采访校方，询问他们对于这篇文章的态度。

    “告诉他们，不接受采访，校方没有态度。”副校长厌烦地说道，说完之后看了一眼校长，对方没有说话，明显是跟他一个意思。

    跟校领导的保守相比，宿舍里就热闹多了。刘济民所在的宿舍被团团包围，大家都在夸赞刘济民说出了他们的心声。

    杨波几人更是兴奋，整个宿舍与有荣焉。工农兵大学生都以刘济民为荣，弯了一周多的腰，终于也在今天直起来了。

    底子不好怎么了？在校努力学习，毕业之后一样能在岗位上发光发热。

    等其余人走后，杨波等人围到了刘济民旁边，乐呵呵地说道：“济民，没想到你真有这本事！”

    “哈哈哈，写得一般，主要是《光明日报》胆子大，真的敢发！”刘济民谦虚地说道。

    李卫国说道：“真给咱们挣面子，让那群高考生看看，谁才是文盲！”

    “为了庆祝济民为咱们发声成功，今天所有人，全聚德，我请客！”杨波往前一步站到凳子上，豪气十足地说道。

    刘济民摸了摸口袋，妈的，刚才《光明日报》的人是不是忘给自己稿费了？

    杨波好像感觉到有什么不对，于是换了一个理由说道：“其实我今天也有喜事儿，是家里的。趁此机会，我请大家吃饭。等济民真成鲁迅了，再请咱们吃饭。”

    “好事儿？”刘济民将手从口袋里掏出来，眼珠一转，觉得这好事儿肯定不小：“好，今天吃定你了，改天稿费下来，我请大家吃老莫！”

    八个人高兴地走下宿舍楼，碰见的每个人都冲刘济民打招呼，不到一天时间，刘济民已经成为学校炙手可热的人物了。
content_en:
In the dormitory, Teacher Wang Bingwen was silenced by Liu Jimin, and when he saw him looking like he was being raped, he was even more angry and helpless.

    "With you students, I..." Wang Bingwen sighed and hurriedly left the dormitory and went straight to the school administration building. The matter had reached this point and was no longer something he could handle. He had to report it to his superiors immediately.

    But even if he didn't report it, the school would probably know about it. After all, the reporter from "Guangming Daily" came to the school in a swaggering manner, and caused a huge sensation among the students. It was difficult for the school leaders not to pay attention.

    When Wang Bingwen walked quickly into the administration building, many leaders were already discussing the matter. Everyone held a copy of "Guangming Daily" in their hands. Some had gloomy faces, while others were full of approval.

    The school leaders were very divided. As soon as Wang Bingwen finished his report, someone told the school leaders: A reporter from Guangming Daily wanted to interview the school and ask them about their attitude towards this article.

    "Tell them that if they don't accept the interview, the school has no attitude." The vice-principal said in annoyance. After finishing speaking, he glanced at the principal. The other party did not speak, obviously he had the same intention.

    Compared with the conservativeness of the school leaders, the dormitory was much more lively. Liu Jimin's dormitory was surrounded by people, and everyone was praising Liu Jimin for speaking out their feelings.

    Yang Bo and others were even more excited, and the whole dormitory was filled with pride. Workers, peasants, soldiers, and college students are all proud of Liu Jimin. After being bent for more than a week, he finally straightened up today.

    What's wrong with your poor foundation? Study hard in school and you will still be able to shine in your job after graduation.

    After the others left, Yang Bo and others gathered around Liu Jimin and said cheerfully: "Jimin, I didn't expect you to be really capable of this!"

    "Hahaha, the writing is average, mainly because Guangming Daily is brave and really dares to publish it!" Liu Jimin said modestly.

    Li Weiguo said: "It really helps us earn face, let those group of college entrance examination students see who is the illiterate!"

    "To celebrate Jimin's success in speaking out for us, today everyone, Quanjude, I'm treating you to a treat!" Yang Bo took a step forward and stood on the stool, saying proudly.

    Liu Jimin touched his pocket, damn, did the people from Guangming Daily forget to pay him the royalties just now?

    Yang Bo seemed to sense something was wrong, so he changed his excuse and said: "Actually, I have a happy event today, it's at home. I'll take this opportunity to treat you all to dinner. When Jimin really becomes Lu Xun, we'll be invited to dinner again."

    "A good thing?" Liu Jimin took his hand out of his pocket and rolled his eyes, thinking that this good thing must be quite big: "Okay, I've decided to eat you today. If the manuscript fee is paid another day, I'll treat everyone to Lao Mo!"

    The eight people happily walked down the dormitory building, and everyone they met greeted Liu Jimin. In less than a day, Liu Jimin had become a popular figure in the school.
